articleBlocks: I started this puzzle thinking about ingredients. Pistachio and coffee seemed like they could fit in a baking or snack category.
But that didn't feel quite right; it was too generic.
Plus, I couldn't see where cookie dough would fit into that.
Then I saw Vanilla. That pointed me toward desserts.
Then it hit me: ice cream!
Each clue is a flavor of ice cream.
Pistachio, coffee, vanilla, cookie dough, and mint chocolate chip all make sense now.
The answer is flavors of ice cream.
Looking back, I realize the key was to think about how these ingredients are commonly used together.

solutionNarrative: Pistachio and Coffee first pulled me toward dessert ingredients, so that was the first path I tested. It held together for a moment, but vanilla never really fit it. The more I pushed that first read, the more the board sounded stitched together instead of naturally solved.

The solve turned when I stopped treating vanilla as just another clue and asked what kind of thing each clue could really be describing. Once I made that shift, I was no longer thinking about dessert ingredients; I was checking whether the earlier clues all behaved like parts of the same real set. That was when the answer became clear, because the remaining clues stopped feeling like separate trivia and started reinforcing the real category.
